2638-3510-4875-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Conspiracy.
2638-3510-4875-6705.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Conspiracy and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Quina.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

3799-5166--86.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Stuffy Doll to take damage.
3799-5166--86.description:
Cause Stuffy Doll to take damage by any method.
Stuffy Doll triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Stuffy Doll.
Repeat from step 2.

1558-3875-4231-5233-7824.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3875-4231-5233-7824.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Bard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2457-3480-4289-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2092-4954-5233.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 7 power.
2092-4954-5233.description:
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding two mana.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Boros Garrison and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and if you control lands that can produce {R} and {G}, use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

2781-5998-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1251-1409-3099-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2034-5003-7696.easyPrerequisites: There's two or more creature cards in your graveyard.
2034-5003-7696.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing HYDRA Troopers, adding {C}{C}.
When HYDRA Troopers dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return HYDRA Troopers from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When HYDRA Troopers enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2263-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
2263-5686-6972.notes: If Geralf's Mindcrusher starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3480-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

1399-1606-4249-7176.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 4.
1399-1606-4249-7176.description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Ley Weaver to gain all creature types.
Activate Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-1115-1563-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

719-2438-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
719-2438-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

1267-7074.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1267-7074.description:
Activate Koh by paying 1 life, causing it to gain Medomai's activated and triggered abilities.
Deal combat damage using Koh, triggering Koh, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat step 2 each turn.

512-4137-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Blossom-Clad Werewolf, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

5310-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bloodghast
When Bloodghast dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning Bloodghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1385-1894-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

511-560-817-3334-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Soldier and Saproling, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1238-2351-4875-5467-6797.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

104-3197-3641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3197-3641.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-2034-2060-6701.description:
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1580-2034-2060-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3054-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
392-3054-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1247-3990-5536.notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control a mana-producing land.
Incubation Druid and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-3990-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Incubation Druid's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any type a land you control could produce.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

64-3617-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Walk and Warden of the Eye each turn.
64-3617-6122.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Warden of the Eye by paying its mana cost.
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Warden of the Eye from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

643-969-3259-4302.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
643-969-3259-4302.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any other creature you control, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

2523-4050-4112.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sharuum, adding one mana of any color.
Sharuum dies, triggering Ratadrabik, creating a nonlegendary copy of Sharuum that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
The Sharuum token enters the battlefield, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Sharuum enters the battlefield, returning any artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
